searchText: I heard more about the proposal on Ethereum Magicians, and I do think stake % targeting can work fine if we allow negative returns. We may have to crank the dial a bit, but we can get people to unstake if we burn enough of their ETH. 🔥 The main opposition I have heard is that Lido? / some other contracts may not be able to deal with negative issuance. To which I would say "fix your contract and replace it". I agree we need to get this done and deployed to the network in 2024. At this point my inclination is % stake targeting, variable return, and negative return if needed to move towards the target. "maybe even more so at high staking ratios, where restaking via staked assets or LSTs enjoys even more network effects" - this 💯 another great reason to get staking % down. Reduce systemic risk from outsized network effects from a contract / application on Ethereum leading to protocol capture.
